# agent-guard

> A zero-dependency local guard and egress proxy for always-on AI agents. It holds API keys in an encrypted vault, injects them on the way out, scans responses for prompt injection, blocks secrets from leaving, records every call in a hash-chained audit log, and has a file-based kill switch.

Install: `npm install -g @nirholas/agent-guard`. Requires Node 20+. License MIT.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, commands, library use, limits
- [Configuration](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): every config key, routes, error codes, audit format
- [Integrations](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/docs/integrations.md): SDK base URLs, MCP servers, containers, token rotation
- [Threat model](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md): what it defends against and what it does not
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules and setup steps for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-guard/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
